series.title: Unemployment rate (February 2026)

series.sourceNote: Reference period: February 2026. Frequency: monthly. Release published: 2026-03-06. Historical release snapshot; not a live or necessarily latest value. Monthly and rolling/quarterly observations are not calendar-year annual averages.
series.evidence: Both the unemployment rate, at 4.4 percent, and the number of unemployed people, at 7.6 million, changed little in February.
